answer: The haven cap is upheld at intake and wharf shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a army of identities in one epoch however much capital it holds, because each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a tundra tag. That is 37 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
